{"text":"# Add Dashboard Weekly Verification (`verifikasi-minggu-ini`)

Connect home weekly verification bar chart (`HomeWeeklyChartCardView`) to `/verifikasi-minggu-ini` endpoint via Clean Architecture (`WeeklyVerificationFeature`, `WeeklyVerificationFeatureModel`, `DashboardRepository`, `WeeklyVerificationDashboardOnlineUseCase`, `HomeController`).

## Proposed Changes

### Domain & Data Layer

#### [NEW] [weekly_verification_feature.dart](file:///Users/accountmac/Abhimantra/source_code_safepedia/flutter/artesis-app/lib/domain/entities/api/response/dashboard/weekly_verification_feature.dart)
- Fields: `String? tanggal`, `String? hari`, `int? total`, plus `copyWith`.
- Helper getter `String get shortDay`: returns first 3 characters of `hari` (or full string if `< 3` chars, `''` if null) to match existing 3-letter chart labels (`Sen`, `Sel`, etc.).

#### [NEW] [weekly_verification_feature_model.dart](file:///Users/accountmac/Abhimantra/source_code_safepedia/flutter/artesis-app/lib/data/models/api/response/dashboard/weekly_verification_feature_model.dart)
- Extends `WeeklyVerificationFeature`, mirroring `StatusSummaryFeatureModel` (`fromJson`, `toJson`, `fromEntity`, `fromDynamic`, top-level JSON helpers).
- Maps `tanggal`, `hari`, and `total: (json['total'] as num?)?.toInt()`.

---

### Repository & Use Case Layer

#### [MODIFY] [dashboard_repository.dart](file:///Users/accountmac/Abhimantra/source_code_safepedia/flutter/artesis-app/lib/domain/repositories/api/dashboard_repository.dart)
- Add `Future<BaseObjectResponseApi<List<WeeklyVerificationFeature>>> weeklyVerification();`.

#### [MODIFY] [dashboard_repository_impl.dart](file:///Users/accountmac/Abhimantra/source_code_safepedia/flutter/artesis-app/lib/data/repositories/api/dashboard_repository_impl.dart)
- Implement `weeklyVerification()` calling `DashboardApi.weeklyVerification().request()` and parsing with `BaseObjectResponseApiModel.fromJson` into `List<WeeklyVerificationFeatureModel>`.

#### [NEW] [weekly_verification_dashboard_online_use_case.dart](file:///Users/accountmac/Abhimantra/source_code_safepedia/flutter/artesis-app/lib/domain/usecases/api/dashboard/weekly_verification_dashboard_online_use_case.dart)
- Extends `NoParamUseCase<BaseObjectResponseApi<List<WeeklyVerificationFeature>>>` delegating `execute()` to `DashboardRepository.weeklyVerification()`.

---

### Presentation Layer (Home)

#### [MODIFY] [home_binding.dart](file:///Users/accountmac/Abhimantra/source_code_safepedia/flutter/artesis-app/lib/presentation/get/bindings/home/home_binding.dart)
- Register `WeeklyVerificationDashboardOnlineUseCase(Get.find<DashboardRepositoryImpl>())` in `_useCasePage()` and pass to `HomeController`.

#### [MODIFY] [home_controller.dart](file:///Users/accountmac/Abhimantra/source_code_safepedia/flutter/artesis-app/lib/presentation/get/controllers/home/list/home_controller.dart)
- Inject `WeeklyVerificationDashboardOnlineUseCase`.
- Replace hardcoded `weeklyDays` and dummy `_weeklyCounts` with `_weeklyVerificationList = <WeeklyVerificationFeature>[].obs`.
- Expose `List<WeeklyVerificationFeature> get weeklyVerificationList`, `List<int> get weeklyCounts`, and `List<String> get weeklyDays` derived from `_weeklyVerificationList`.
- Add `_fetchWeeklyVerification()` called in `onInit()` (swallowing errors like `_fetchStatusSummary()`).

#### [MODIFY] [home_weekly_chart_card_view.dart](file:///Users/accountmac/Abhimantra/source_code_safepedia/flutter/artesis-app/lib/presentation/ui/pages/home/list/views/home_weekly_chart_card_view.dart)
- Wrap both `CustomPaint` and day-label `Row` inside a single `Obx` so both bars (`controller.weeklyCounts`) and day labels (`controller.weeklyDays`) react to API response.

---

### Tests

#### [NEW] [weekly_verification_feature_model_test.dart](file:///Users/accountmac/Abhimantra/source_code_safepedia/flutter/artesis-app/test/data/models/weekly_verification_feature_model_test.dart)
- Unit test verifying `WeeklyVerificationFeatureModel.fromJson`, `toJson`, and `shortDay`.

## Verification Plan

### Automated Tests
- Run `fvm flutter test test/data/models/weekly_verification_feature_model_test.dart` (or `flutter test` if FVM not active).
- Run `fvm flutter analyze` to verify zero analysis issues.
","absolutePath":"implementation_plan.artifact.md"}
